summary.business_type: Astrology & Spiritual Advisory (Direct-to-Consumer / Online Professional Service)

top_findings.title: Multiple H1 Tags on /home Page
top_findings.description: home.html contains 4 separate <h1> tags for Refund Policy, Privacy Policy, and Terms of Service sections alongside the main hero title, diluting topical authority.

top_findings.title: Missing AggregateRating in Schema for Google Star Snippets
top_findings.description: The site displays '4.98 rating · 1000+ consultations' visually, but omits AggregateRating JSON-LD markup, missing out on rich star snippets in SERPs.

top_findings.title: Missing Security & Cache Headers in Cloudflare Configuration
top_findings.description: Missing HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, and Referrer-Policy headers.

top_findings.title: LCP Hero Image Not Preloaded with High Priority
top_findings.description: Hero portrait (/pandit.webp) lacks fetchpriority='high' and <link rel='preload'>, delaying Largest Contentful Paint.

top_findings.title: Missing llms.txt and AI Crawler Content-Signal
top_findings.description: No /llms.txt or /llms-full.txt published for AI aggregators (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini).

quick_wins: Add AggregateRating JSON-LD to ProfessionalService schema to immediately qualify for Google search rich star snippets.
Fix H1 tags in home.html by downgrading policy headings from <h1> to <h2>/<h3>.
Add fetchpriority='high' to on both index.html and home.html.
Add width and height attributes to review images to prevent Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
Deploy a standard /llms.txt file summarizing Acharya Narender Ji's Vedic astrology services, pricing, and consultation process.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Clean robots.txt allowing all major search engine crawlers
Valid XML sitemap declared in robots.txt and accessible at /sitemap.xml
Proper canonical tags pointing to preferred https://www.astrojak.in/ URLs
Fast server-side static rendering via Cloudflare edge CDN
Zero crawl errors or infinite redirect loops

findings.title: Missing Security Headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options)
findings.description: The site does not emit HTTP Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS), X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, or Referrer-Policy headers.
findings.recommendation: Configure response headers in Cloudflare Pages via _headers or Cloudflare Transform Rules.

findings.title: Sitemap Lacks Image and Freshness Metadata
findings.description: sitemap.xml lists only two URLs without image sitemap tags or automated lastmod update timestamps.
findings.recommendation: Add image tags for pandit.webp and review testimonials to assist Google Images indexation.

categories.name: Content Quality & E-E-A-T
what_works: High information density score (0.86 - 1.0) with zero detectable AI boilerplate filler phrases
Strong first-person authority and credentials (Acharya Narender Ji, 20+ years experience, 1000+ consultations)
Clear pricing transparency (₹101 intro, ₹999 kundali, ₹1499 detailed) establishing commercial trust
Transparent refund policy and privacy safeguards published

findings.title: Lack of Informational / Educational Content Architecture
findings.description: The site is currently a 2-page sales funnel with no blog or informational content targeting top-of-funnel queries (e.g. Manglik Dosh remedies, Sade Sati phases, Kundli matching rules).
findings.recommendation: Build a hub-and-spoke content cluster covering high-volume Vedic astrology informational queries.

findings.title: Minor Typographic Spacing Errors in Section Headings
findings.description: 'Need Clear Answers?Ask Your Kundli' and 'Online VedicAstrology Consultation& Kundli Analysis' have missing spaces.
findings.recommendation: Add proper spacing between punctuation marks and words in heading tags.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Optimized homepage title tag (68 characters) with target keywords: Vedic Astrology Consultation, Kundali Analysis, ASTROJAK
Compelling meta description with pricing and booking call-to-action
Open Graph and Twitter Card tags configured with high-res 1200x630 share image
Clean, semantic section landmarks and accessible link anchors

findings.title: Multiple H1 Tags on /home Page
findings.description: home.html contains 4 <h1> elements (hero title plus Refund, Privacy, and Terms headings).
findings.recommendation: Keep exactly one <h1> per page. Change policy section headings to <h2>.

findings.title: Inverted Breadcrumb Hierarchy
findings.description: Breadcrumb schema defines /home as position 1 and / as position 2, which contradicts canonical site structure.
findings.recommendation: Set / as position 1 ('Home') and secondary pages as position 2.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Comprehensive JSON-LD with WebSite, ProfessionalService, OfferCatalog, and FAQPage
Detailed Offer entities with exact INR pricing and descriptions
FAQPage schema matching visible on-page accordion text for Google FAQ rich snippet eligibility

findings.title: Omission of AggregateRating Schema
findings.description: Visual 4.98 rating is not translated into Schema.org AggregateRating markup.
findings.recommendation: Nest aggregateRating under ProfessionalService with ratingValue: 4.98 and reviewCount: 1000.

findings.title: Missing Physical Address or OnlineService Distinction
findings.description: ProfessionalService schema lacks postalAddress, which Google prefers for local/service entities.
findings.recommendation: Add PostalAddress with addressCountry: IN or specify OnlineBusiness service types.

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: Fully inlined, critical CSS avoiding external render-blocking stylesheets
Zero client-side JavaScript rendering requirement (pure static HTML)
Modern WebP image format used for primary hero photo
Native loading='lazy' configured on below-the-fold testimonial images

findings.title: Hero LCP Image Not Priority-Loaded
findings.description: The main hero image (/pandit.webp) is rendered without fetchpriority='high', postponing LCP paint.
findings.recommendation: Add fetchpriority='high' and <link rel='preload' as='image' href='/pandit.webp'> in <head>.

findings.title: Missing Speculation Rules for Instant Navigation
findings.description: Navigation between / and /home requires standard HTTP roundtrip instead of instant prerender.
findings.recommendation: Include a Speculation Rules script block to prerender /home upon link hover.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: Zero WAF blocking: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and OAI-SearchBot all return 200 OK
Clean server-rendered semantic HTML accessible without JavaScript execution
Clear pricing and service definitions readily extractable by LLMs and answer engines

findings.title: Missing /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt Discovery Files
findings.description: AI agents and search crawlers checking for /llms.txt receive HTTP 404.
findings.recommendation: Publish a clean /llms.txt documenting services, pricing, Acharya's credentials, and FAQs in Markdown.

findings.title: No Content-Signal Policy Declared
findings.description: No Content-Signal HTTP header or robots.txt line declaring AI scraping preferences.
findings.recommendation: Add 'Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no' to robots.txt.

categories.name: Images & Visual Layout
what_works: Mobile-responsive layout verified across desktop, laptop, tablet, and mobile viewports
Touch targets meet accessibility guidelines (>44px)
Hero portrait has explicit width and height dimensions preventing CLS

findings.title: Primary CTA Button Located Below Initial Mobile Fold
findings.description: Visual analysis indicates the primary reservation CTA requires scrolling on smaller screens.
findings.recommendation: Add a sticky mobile booking bar or elevate the primary CTA above the fold on mobile.

findings.title: Review Testimonial Images Use JPG Format
findings.description: Review screenshots are uncompressed JPG files without explicit width/height dimensions.
findings.recommendation: Convert to WebP and add explicit width/height to avoid cumulative layout shift.
